provenance.notes: Public elementary schools (amenity=school named …小学校) and childcare (amenity=kindergarten|childcare) inside the catalog boundaries of 越谷市 and 草加市. Records follow ReferencePlaceRecord. OSM tags 幼稚園, 認定こども園 and 保育園 alike, so facilityType comes from the name: 幼稚園 = kindergarten, こども園 = kodomoen, otherwise hoikuen. Checked against the cities' own lists: all 30 越谷市立 and 21 草加市立 elementary schools, all 18 越谷 and 15 草加 private kindergartens, and the 認定こども園 of both cities are covered; しらとり保育園 is しらとりこども園 on 越谷市's list, and わかばの森ナーサリー (not in OSM) is added from that list at its GSI-geocoded address. A facility OSM maps as both a node and a way is kept once.
